text: Not recommended. I arrived at the scheduled time, but understood that I had to wait. After an hour, I was told to wait another 15 minutes. Would I wait that long? Of course I was going to wait! In the end, I waited 1 hour and 25 minutes from my scheduled time. There was no explanation whatsoever. Was the doctor late? Were there too many patients? Was there queue jumping? Or was there duplicate queuing? I could think of all the possibilities. The staff needs to improve this aspect: managing appointments and communicating with patients. This is a service job; I paid for it, and the appointment time was as provided. Please prioritize this. I wasted a lot of time waiting. One star is enough.
